gbm_population_evidence.quote: Phase 3 Randomized, Double-blind, Controlled Study of ICT-107 in Glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: Autologous dendritic cells pulsed with peptides associated with tumor antigens

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Phase 3 Randomized Double-blind, Controlled Study of ICT-107 With Maintenance Temozolomide (TMZ) in Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma Following Resection and Concomitant TMZ Chemoradiotherapy

role_evidence.quote: Autologous dendritic cells pulsed with peptides associated with tumor antigens

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous dendritic cell vaccine pulsed with six synthetic tumour-associated peptides
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Reinfusion with the pulsed dendritic cells should stimulate cytotoxic T cells to specifically target glioblastoma tumour cells.

role_evidence.quote: Arm 1 will receive ICT-107 in combination with the standard of care, temozolomide (TMZ).

source_quote.quote: All subjects must have glioblastoma tissue that has tumor assessment for MGMT methylation status prior to randomization (for stratification).
Subjects with glioblastoma mutated IDH by Immunohistochemistry (IHC)

coder_notes: ICT-107 is a dendritic-cell vaccine, an excluded intervention type; no other investigational agent, so no candidate. cns5_terminology coded cns5 because IDH-mutated tumours are excluded (IDH-wildtype required) even though the label is 'Glioblastoma Multiforme'. HLA-A2 positivity is a germline immune-typing requirement and is not listed. TMZ is not a registered intervention but is described in the arms and is given in both arms.
